scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w @notach/shared && npm run dev -w @notach/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @notach/shared && npm run build -w @notach/api && npm run dev -w @notach/api
scripts.check:ai: npm run build -w @notach/shared && npm run build -w @notach/api && npm run check:ai -w @notach/api
scripts.verify:ai: npm run build -w @notach/shared && npm run build -w @notach/api && npm run check:ai -w @notach/api -- --generate
scripts.emulators: npm run config:sync && firebase emulators:start --only auth,firestore --project default
scripts.build: npm run build -w @notach/shared && npm run build -w @notach/api && npm run build -w @notach/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @notach/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @notach/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:rules: npm run config:sync && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-notach "npm run test:rules -w @notach/api"
